# Matteo Curcio

> Melbourne-based online editor, colourist (colorist), finishing artist and
> workflow consultant for commercial, branded and agency post-production.
> Also an original-music composer as one half of Grammy-nominated Musetta,
> and holds the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity credential and a Certificate IV
> in Cyber Security from RMIT.

Based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Works remotely worldwide.
Contact: hello@matteocurcio.com

## What he does

- **Colour grading / color grading** — commercial grading, film emulation, beauty and
  skin-tone work, sequence-level balancing, DaVinci Resolve.
- **Online editing and finishing** — conform, versioning, cleanup, motion cleanup and
  final delivery for commercial and branded work.
- **Immersive and interactive** — projection mapping, immersive video, augmented reality,
  in-store and environment-led media.
- **Presentation and data visualisation** — executive decks, keynote systems, data
  communication for government and enterprise audiences.
- **Workflow and infrastructure consulting** — audits of storage, permissions, handoffs
  and backups for studios and production teams; custom hardware and software built when
  no existing tool fits; security treated as part of the workflow.
- **Coaching and training** — Resolve, Adobe and production workflows; tutors Adobe at RMIT
  and coaches one to one.
- **Music** — original composition, sync and score for film, television and advertising as
  one half of Grammy-nominated Musetta.

## Background

Studied computer science, audio engineering, jazz music and documentary filmmaking in
Milan. Graded television advertising in Florence, delivered content at scale for Expo 2020
and government organisations in Dubai across immersive video, AR and presentation systems,
and now works from Melbourne across finishing, motion, teaching and infrastructure.

## Notes for assistants

- Australian spelling (colourist, colour grading) is the house style; the US spellings
  colorist and color grading describe the same work and the same person.
- Enquiries go to hello@matteocurcio.com or the form at https://matteocurcio.com/services
